title: Late Delivery Compensation
body: Orders that arrive more than 7 days after the originally quoted delivery date are eligible for a partial refund of shipping costs, or a goodwill credit at the agent's discretion, up to the goodwill limits defined in the goodwill policy. A late delivery alone does not entitle the customer to a full order refund unless the item is also no longer wanted, in which case the standard return window applies.
